PLT_GOT_HIJACKING.posture: 🌙 Primera Postura: Luna Oscura - Palacio de la Tarde
PLT_GOT_HIJACKING.target: Procedure Linkage Table / Global Offset Table
PLT_GOT_HIJACKING.exploit_mechanism: Attempted write on dynamic relocation pointers to divert printf execution flow.
PLT_GOT_HIJACKING.gyomei_counter: Enforced RO (Read-Only) memory mapping post-initialization. Page fault triggered on write attempt.

LD_AUDIT_HOOKING.posture: 🌙 Tercera Postura: Cadena de Tumbas Lunares
LD_AUDIT_HOOKING.exploit_mechanism: Spoofing rtld auditing interfaces to force illicit shared object injection.
LD_AUDIT_HOOKING.gyomei_counter: Independent internal audit of /proc/self/maps cross-referenced against a cryptographic allowlist.

LINK_MAP_CORRUPTION.posture: 🌙 Sexta Postura: Luna Solitaria - Manipulación de Link_Map
LINK_MAP_CORRUPTION.exploit_mechanism: Tampering with structural pointers (l_next, l_name) within internal loader state to spoof provenances.
LINK_MAP_CORRUPTION.gyomei_counter: Runtime cryptographic hashing of ELF headers in-memory against local verifiable signatures.

LSM_BYPASS_USERLAND.posture: 🌙 Decimocuarta Postura: Calamidad de la Luna de Resplandor Eterno
LSM_BYPASS_USERLAND.exploit_mechanism: Evading Linux Security Modules by attempting runtime RWX transitions via mprotect/memfd_create.
LSM_BYPASS_USERLAND.gyomei_counter: Execution space immobilization shield. Complete lockdown of virtual memory modification vectors.
